The post-deletion test must compile the genuine C++ source from the retained `params.h`, execute the native candidate for all 25 raw inputs, and compare the complete report against this independent original report. It runs the same current checker/candidate ELFs in both the source checkout and a fresh private header-only root under an exec audit, sealing their actual hashes before and after; the older ELF hashes above are provenance only. CLI failure stderr contains run-specific paths and Python tracebacks, so the retained raw bytes prove the original observation while the maintained comparison checks the exact status, stdout policy, failure diagnostics and output-file phase. This fixture is not native-generated expected output or a substitute for the earlier fresh original/native proof.
